# Gear & Grit

> > Cycling gear reviews, gravel and mountain bike coverage, and smart training insights for riders who care about the details.

Gear & Grit covers the latest in cycling technology, from Shimano groupsets and component reviews to bikepacking gear and virtual training platforms like Zwift. The site combines technical product analysis with training guides and stories from the cycling community.

## Key Topics

- Shimano GRX Di2
- Zwift Games 2026
- Racing Score
- Gravel bikes
- Bikepacking
- Steel frames
- Wireless groupsets
- FTP testing
- Smart racing
- XTR components
- 1x12 drivetrains
- Progressive training
- Virtual cycling
- Mountain bike geometry
- Time trials
